description: This file defines React components and utility functions related to emoji handling and avatar display in a chat application. It includes components for emoji selection, avatar rendering based on models, and emoji URL generation.

methods.name: getEmojiUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for an emoji image based on its unified code and style, using a CDN.

methods.name: AvatarPicker
methods.description: A React component rendering an emoji picker with custom URL loader and handling emoji selection.

methods.name: Avatar
methods.description: A React component that displays a user avatar based on a model type or custom avatar string.

methods.name: EmojiAvatar
methods.description: A React component displaying an individual emoji based on its unified code, using a specified size.
